message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine that runs very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware by tiering experts across VRAM, RAM, and NVMe SSD.

**Core system**
- Runs **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B params, ~18B active, 1M context, MIT) and **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** (748B, MIT), plus experimental **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash** (428B
